title: Waaye Ali Ali Ali Akbaram
body:
Waye Ali Ali Ali Akberam
Shabh E Nabi Ali Ali Akberam
Ya Waladi Ali Ali Akberam
1.Aayi Gul E Gulzar Ali Akberam
Sham E Shab E Taar Ali Akberam
Yar E Man E Zaar Ali Akberam
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Aayi Gul E Beqaar Ali Akberam
Shahbiye Muqtar Ali Akberam
Laila Azaadar Ali Akberam
